notes: Target per good: StaticModifiersV2 score_0_1 rank-uniform over viable locations, mapped to [output_min, output_max]; fitted on the locations where the good is the game RGO (data/raw/vanilla/location_raw_material_1337.csv). The game keeps its RGO; rows shape output only.

Relevance pruning: a (good, attribute class) row exists only where the good is the RGO in >= min_rgo_locations_per_class locations of that class; |modifier| < prune_below is dropped and refitted into the intercept. Chosen 2026-09-20 from a grid: ~300 rows across 25 goods, at most ~13 per climate class, same held-out fit on RGO locations as the unpruned 1,450-row model.
rgo_floor: RGO locations predicted below this (and RGO locations the data calls non-viable) go to rgo_floor.csv for the constructor floor carve-out, which stays.
goods: empty = every table in tables_directory.

fit_on weighted_viable: least squares over all viable locations with RGO locations weighted rgo_weight (5); fitting on RGO locations alone overfitted goods with under ~200 RGO locations (held-out R2 negative for sugar, pepper, saffron, cocoa). min_rgo_share_per_class makes relevance adaptive: a class row needs the good as RGO in at least 10% of its RGO locations (and at least min_rgo_locations_per_class).

2026-09-20 grid over rgo_weight/share/prune: weight 10, share 0, prune 0.10 gives 226 rows (max 18 per class), median held-out R2 on RGO locations 0.38 (goods with >=250 RGO locations 0.54, smaller goods 0.22, two negative). RGO-only fitting and stricter relevance both overfit small goods.
